name: @avatark/spatial-ecology-runtime
description: Executes Sprint 16's spatial-ecology derivation: spatial membership indexing, topology reachability/permeability, Patch state derivation from Sprint 7/13/15 state, Territory claim/pressure aggregation over Sprint 12's own HomeRange, Route state, spatial movement context, and spatial snapshot diffing. Host-neutral, database-neutral, franchise-neutral. Composes existing systems; introduces no second causal, movement, occupancy, territory, or adaptation engine.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/membershipIndex.test.ts src/topologyResolution.test.ts src/patchStateResolution.test.ts src/territoryResolution.test.ts src/movementContext.test.ts src/routeResolution.test.ts src/snapshotDiff.test.ts src/inMemoryRepositories.test.ts src/livingForestSpatialEcologyPortability.test.ts
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
